description: This file contains a unit test class for the SyncWorker component in an Android app, specifically testing the work scheduling and execution using WorkManager in a Hilt-enabled environment.

classes.name: SyncWorkerTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that verifies the behavior of SyncWorker using WorkManager's testing framework in an Android environment with Hilt dependencies.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the WorkManager with a custom configuration for testing, including setting logging level and executor.

methods.name: testSyncWork
methods.description: Tests the synchronization work process by enqueuing the SyncWorker request, verifying initial state, and then simulating constraints being met to check the worker transition to running state.
